changelog:
- Fixed Other Apps Losing Internet: Disabled the experimental 0.0.0.0/0 device-wide TUN until native Layer-3 tun2socks is bundled so leaving Fokk Browser never disrupts WhatsApp, banking, YouTube, or other apps.
- Live-Only Dynamic Location Picker (Android & Desktop): Removed hardcoded dead countries; location picker now dynamically shows only live verified relays from the 6-hour Sentinel manifest with real cities, relay counts, and measured ping.
- Faster Fokk Mesh Browsing: Added a 90s Sticky Fastest-Relay fast-path (eliminating 3x parallel socket flooding per webpage asset) and doubled pre-warmed 2-hop circuit pool from 2 to 4.
- Legal & Compliance Hardening: Purged residential ISP relays (Korea Telecom, RCN) and added automated Layer-7 ASN residential-ISP filtering in Sentinel; zero hardcoded IPs in binaries; RFC 1929 auth + TLS-over-SOCKS5 ready for self-hosted relays.
